definitions.explanation: A very young child, typically from birth to around one year old.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{生|う}まれました。
{赤|あか}ちゃんが{泣|な}いている。
{赤|あか}ちゃんに{名前|なまえ}をつける。
examples.english: To give the baby a name.

notes:
{赤|あか}ちゃん is an affectionate term for 'baby.'

Etymology: {赤|あか} (red, referring to a newborn's skin color) + ちゃん (affectionate suffix).

Common collocations:
- {赤|あか}ちゃんが{生|う}まれる (a baby is born)
- {赤|あか}ちゃんを{抱|だ}く (to hold a baby)
- {赤|あか}ちゃんに{授乳|じゅにゅう}する (to breastfeed a baby)

Related words:
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}: slightly more formal/neutral term for baby
- {乳児|にゅうじ}: medical/formal term for infant
